corrected_content.problem:
![](images/c5/c5f7ed5a3d4763df369a9bc76cc934e5dd2c7f85dd074f623ae4f59f77f8e0c1.png)

Calculate $$
\displaystyle \int_{C}ds,
$$ where $C$ is the arc of a semicircle of radius $3$ traversed once in the counterclockwise direction, as shown above.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The integral of $1$ with respect to arc length is the length of the curve. A semicircle of radius $3$ has length half of $2\pi(3)$, so $$\int_C ds=3\pi.$$
